text: Figure 6.5: Details of defining ExclusiveAreas in BSWMDT In addition to defining that a BswModuleEntity can enter an exclusive area or completely runs in an exclusive area, it is possible to define possible nesting orders of exclusive areas. Furthermore one can define at which level of a nesting order function calls are invoked from the BswModuleEntity. The information on nesting orders can be used to analyze the call tree with respect to resource locking scenarios. Class ExclusiveAreaNestingOrder Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::CommonStructure::InternalBehavior Note This meta-class represents the ability to define a nesting order of ExclusiveAreas. A nesting order (that may occur in the executable code) is formally defined to be able to analyze the resource locking behavior. Base ARObject, Referrable Aggregated by InternalBehavior .exclusiveAreaNestingOrder Attribute Type Mult. Kind Note exclusiveArea (ordered) ExclusiveArea * ref This represents a specific scenario of how Exclusive Areas can be used in terms of the nesting order.
